examples.text: I excelled everyone else with my exam results.

Because when our friends excel us, that gives them a feeling of importance; but when we excel them, that gives them a feeling of inferiority and arouses envy and jealousy.

glosses: To be much better than others.

examples.text: But it is as a destroyer of grasshoppers that the dickcissel excels.
